name: trust-strip-01
title: Trust Strip 01 - Short Assurance Statements, One Per Mark
description: A narrow single-row band of short assurance statements, each with a mark, and no visible heading. Prism draws the frame and the caller ships the words, so a strip of certifications, a strip of compliance marks and a strip of a customer count are the same component and none of them is Prism's to assert. Every string is passed in as a prop.
